Description (Fluff): Covers a wide array of possible drugs, but substances of this caliber share a few things in common - they tend not to have harmful effects beyond an altered state of mind while active, which fully subsides once the drug runs its course.

Name: Kiss of the Earth
Description (Fluff): A skilled alchemist can distill medicinal herbs into a potion that clots wounds almost instantaneously, saving an otherwise mortally-wounded soldier from impending death.
Effects: When consumed, until you take a full night's rest the first 3 stacks of Bleeding you would gain, instead you don't. If you already have stacks of Bleeding, remove them and count them against the total.

Name: Predator's Cry
Description (Fluff): Straining the blood of tigers, bears, and other hunters together with certain medicinal herbs produces a curative that helps the drinker push through weakness and numbness in their limbs.
Effects: When consumed, until you take a full night's rest the first 3 stacks of Crippled or Slowed you would gain, instead you don't. If you already have stacks of either, remove them and count them against the total.

Name: Revivification Draught
Description (Fluff): A carefully balanced regenerative tonic, prized by field medics and battle-mages alike for its versatility -- rather than a single burst of healing, it mends the body steadily over time, its effects equally capable of closing shallow wounds or restoring deeper reserves of vitality as the drinker's body needs most.
Effects: When consumed, you heal 1 Health (your choice of Shallow or Deep) at the start of each of your next 4 turns.

Name: Reeler
Description (Fluff): When the contents of this flask are mixed, traces of electrically-charged stone react with alchemical reagents to produce a blast closely resembling a small burst of lightning, leaving whatever it strikes reeling from the shock.
Effects: On a hit it deals 8 Fire damage and the target gains 4 + [Diamonds] stacks of Harried.

Name: Elemental Warding Amulet
Description (Fluff): A silver pendant encrusted with gemstones matching one or more of the elements - rubies and garnets for Fire, sapphires for Frost, brilliant-cut diamonds for Brilliant, and dark obsidian for Shadow. The enchantment serves a simple purpose: protecting the wearer from elemental harm.
Effects: When this enhancement is created, choose Fire, Frost, Brilliant, or Shadow. Once per encounter, you may gain 1 stack of Ward of the chosen type (2 stacks if this enhancement is Level 2).
Main Materials: The opposite of the chosen element - Fire for Frost, Brilliant for Shadow, and vice versa

Name: Mendicant's Cord
Description (Fluff): A sash woven from common linen and cotton thread, yet as strong and sturdy as if it were spun from steel, infused with its power through spiritually-charged rituals and long meditation.
Effects: As a Move, you may touch yourself or a willing adjacent creature and shift up to 2 points from one of their Defenses to another - the raised Defense can't end up higher than the lowered one's new value.

Name: Scaraculpi's Gleaming Justice
Description (Fluff): A ritual whose knowledge was lost to mortal smiths - rumored to have demanded immense sacrifice to power, whether in blood or in rare and costly reagents. Whatever the cost, the result is a weapon of unrivaled potency, and value to match.
Effects: The wielder has Good Luck on attacks made with this weapon.

Name: Worry Token
Description (Fluff): These tokens appear in virtually every culture, taking forms as varied as a revered ancestor's finger bone, a rune-etched jewel, or a vial of holy water - discerning their true nature usually takes real expertise or a talent for divination.
Effects: Worn around the neck through a full night's rest, the token fills with three charges, losing any it had before. As a Move, you may draw on the token, expending 1 charge; the GM secretly determines the effect, which you don't learn in advance (though its result may be obvious once it happens). More often than not, nothing happens. Otherwise: you heal 1 Health; you gain a +2 bonus on the second flip you make within the next 2 hours; before sunset, the next person you speak to thinks slightly more favorably of you (no effect at night); within the next hour, the next attack made against one of your Defenses gives that Defense a +2 bonus against it; your next attack ignores the target's Physical Resist; or after 6 hours you draw a card.

Name: Legbreaker
Description (Fluff): A dense charge of compressed metal shavings and alchemical reagents, built by alchemists more interested in force than fire. When triggered, the reagents detonate with a concussive shockwave alone, strong enough to knock a grown man clean off his feet without ever raising the temperature.
Effects: On a hit it deals 8 Physical damage and pushes the target 4 meters.

Name: Harrowing Ichor
Description (Fluff): A vial of thick, black ichor drawn from places light has never properly reached. When shattered it seeps into an unnatural, writhing darkness, carrying with it something ancient and predatory that lingers just long enough to remind its target exactly how alone they truly are.
Effects: On a hit it deals 7 Shadow damage and the target gains 2 + [Hearts] stacks of Frightened.

Name: Oozejar
Description (Fluff): A crude, oversized cousin to the more refined Immaculate Adhesive, brewed with far less care for precision and far more for sheer volume. The resulting glob of alchemical ooze engulfs everything nearby in a thick, clinging muck that saps the strength from every swing and the speed from every step.
Effects: Make an attack against all creatures adjacent to the target. On a hit, each target gains 4 stacks of Slowed and 3 stacks of Crippled.

Name: Windrunner's Draught
Description (Fluff): Brewed from herbs gathered on high, wind-scoured peaks, this thin, sharp-smelling tonic is favored by scouts and skirmishers who need to close distance in a hurry - or open it.
Effects: When consumed, you are Hasted five times.

Name: Thornskin Elixir
Description (Fluff): A thick, bitter tonic brewed from bramble-thorns and clotting herbs, said to turn a soldier's own wounds against whoever dealt them.
Effects: When consumed, the next 2 times a damaging attack hits you this encounter, the attacker gains a stack of Bleeding. You also gain 1 stack of Protected.

Name: Spellblade's Sipper
Description (Fluff): Battle-mages brew this draft before wading into a fight they've already sized up, tuning their strikes to exploit a known weakness while the opposite element's essence settles protectively over their skin.
Effects: When this Potion is created, choose Fire, Frost, Brilliant, or Shadow. When consumed, your next 4 attacks this encounter deal the chosen type of damage instead of Physical, and you gain 3 stacks of Ward against the opposite element - Frost for Fire, Brilliant for Shadow, and vice versa.

Name: Fatebinder's Cordial
Description (Fluff): A shimmering, faintly restless cordial brewed by those who read the cards as much as they read the battlefield - meant to be saved for the moment a fight is about to turn.
Effects: When consumed, the next 5 attacks you make this encounter have Good Luck, and the next time you Down a creature this encounter, draw 2 cards.
